correctness.rationale: For every \(d\ge3\), the exact intrinsic-volume formula gives \(S=\sum_{i<j}a_i a_j s_{ij}\). Weighted Cauchy proves \(S^2\le AB\). The length variance \(Q\) gives \(A=A_*-Q/2\), while positive-semidefinite frame trace \(E\) gives \(B=B_*-E/2\). Thus the sharp constant and nonnegative decomposition follow, and \(Q=E=0\) forces the regular-simplex Gram matrix for \(d+1\) columns. An exact fraction fixture, eleven simplex checks, and 900 reproducible numerical configurations corroborate the stated identities without replacing the all-dimensional proof.
